messages:
yuki: Quick note: while bringing Mira v1 int8 online I hit a detok / BLEU regression concentrated on Cantonese lines with emoji ZWJ chains and also a small RTL bracket-mirroring glitch when shortctx is used. Sample below.

anna: please paste the sample outputs :eyes:

yuki: input: "你講"); actually Cantonese + emoji zwj chain (raw): "你講👍
\u2764
🔥好正"
 reference detok: "你講 👍 ❤️ 🔥 好正"
 mira-int32 detok: "你講 👍
❤️
🔥 好正" (ok)
 mira-int8 detok: "你講 👍 好正" (ZWJ cluster collapsed, emoji lost)

liang: wow, so tokens around the ZWJ cluster are being collapsed after quant kernel. Do we have token ids pre/post quant?

yuki: pulling token ids now. Quick diff: multiple token ids map to a single fallback token inside the int8 detok path.

kevin: could be an SSE/AVX fused detok path that mishandles surrogate pairs or >0xFFFF codepoints under int8 simd loop. Any tokenizer vocab changes?

eva: BLEU drop numbers: fp16 baseline 34.2, mira-int32 33.9, mira-int8 31.7. Drop mainly on samples with emoji/ZWJ. Dashboard: https://ci.redwood/internals/mira-quant/cantonese-zwj (internal).

anna: let's get a minimal repro command for CI.

yuki: run locally: `python ci/evals/run_detok_check.py --model mira_v1 --quant int8 --subset cantonese_emoji --max-samples 200` -> detok mismatches int8: 18/200 vs int32: 4/200.

liang: I suspect the KV-cache concat or detokenizer fused kernel uses a narrow-codepoint path that fails for multi-codepoint graphemes. I'll try bypassing the fused kernel and run scalar fallback.

kevin: @ops-bot can we spin a canary with --no-fused-detok for mira-v1 int8?

ops-bot: Deploy queued: canary mira-v1 int8 (no-fused-detok) -> staging-ml-2. ETA ~16m.

eva: also observed an RTL case: Arabic parentheses + shortctx produced mirrored brackets on int8 in chat sampling. Might be related.

anna: Liang/kevin pair up on kernel + tokenizer and add a unit test for emoji ZWJ chains under ci/testcases/locale/zwj_emoji.txt.

liang: opening PR with reproducer + fallback to scalar detok for grapheme clusters >1 codepoint.

yuki: I'll rerun full cantonese suite after canary lands.

ops-bot: Canary finished on staging-ml-2. Detok mismatches reduced to 5/200 for int8 (no-fused-detok).

yuki: promising. If scalar fallback fixes it we should add a model-config toggle to enable fused detok except for flagged locales.

kevin: agreed. Also add perf metrics to the rollout notes so we can quantify cost of fallback.

anna: great triage. Keep this thread updated and ping when CI regresses/passes.
